title: Menu identification
prompt: What shows all the food and drinks you can order?
hint: It is the list in a restaurant that lists all dishes and drinks.

ja.prompt: 注文できるすべての料理や飲み物を何が示しますか？
ja.hint: レストランで注文できる料理や飲み物の一覧のことです。

local.prompt: What shows all the food and drinks you can order?
local.hint: It is the list in a restaurant that lists all dishes and drinks.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt ʃoʊz ɔːl ðə fuːd ənd drɪŋks jʊ kæn ˈɔːrdər?
local_pron.hint: ɪt ɪz ðə lɪst ɪn ə ˈrɛstrɒnt ðæt lɪsts ɔːl dɪʃɪz ənd drɪŋks.

zh.prompt: 什麼顯示你可以點的所有食物和飲料？
zh.hint: 它是在餐廳列出可點食物和飲料的清單。

en.prompt: What shows all the food and drinks you can order?
en.hint: It is the list in a restaurant that lists all dishes and drinks.

en_pron.prompt: What shows all the food and drinks you can order?
en_pron.hint: It is the list in a restaurant that lists all dishes and drinks.

title: Waiter role
hint: Say that the waiter brings or serves food to customers.

ja.prompt: ウェイターは何をしますか？
ja.hint: ウェイターが客に料理を運んだり提供したりすることを言いましょう。
ja.sample: ウェイターは料理を提供します。

local.hint: Say that the waiter brings or serves food to customers.

local_pron.hint: seɪ ðæt ðə ˈweɪtər brɪŋz ɔːr sɜːrvz fuːd tuː ˈkʌstəmərz.

zh.hint: 說明服務生會把食物送給顧客或提供食物。

en.hint: Say that the waiter brings or serves food to customers.

en_pron.hint: Say that the waiter brings or serves food to customers.

title: Reservation effect
prompt: What does making a reservation do for you?
hint: Say that it saves a table for a specific day and time so you do not wait.
sample: It saves a table for a certain day and time.

ja.prompt: 予約をすることはあなたに何をしてくれますか？
ja.hint: 特定の日と時間に席を確保してくれて、待たなくて済むことを言いましょう。
ja.sample: 予約は特定の日と時間に席を確保してくれます。

local.prompt: What does making a reservation do for you?
local.hint: Say that it saves a table for a specific day and time so you do not wait.
local.sample: It saves a table for a certain day and time.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt dʌz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə ˌrɛzərˈveɪʃən duː fɔːr juː?
local_pron.hint: seɪ ðæt ɪt seɪvz ə ˈteɪbəl fɔːr ə ˈspɛsɪfɪk deɪ ənd taɪm soʊ juː doʊ nɒt weɪt.
local_pron.sample: ɪt seɪvz ə ˈteɪbəl fɔːr ə ˈsɜːrtən deɪ ənd taɪm.

zh.hint: 說它為你保留了特定日期和時間的桌位，這樣就不用等待。
zh.sample: 它為某一天和時間保留了一張桌子。

en.prompt: What does making a reservation do for you?
en.hint: Say that it saves a table for a specific day and time so you do not wait.
en.sample: It saves a table for a certain day and time.

en_pron.prompt: What does making a reservation do for you?
en_pron.hint: Say that it saves a table for a specific day and time so you do not wait.
en_pron.sample: it SAYVZ a TAY-buhl for a SUR-tuhn day and time.
